premise: The excavator trundles up to lift the supply pod's heaviest crate, but Maya has already picked it up with one hand: on the Moon it weighs a sixth of what it would at home.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Boasting Traveller', who claimed a giant leap in faraway Rhodes, turned: on the Moon the boast comes true.
lesson: Where you are changes what you can do.
learning: On the Moon things weigh only about a sixth of what they weigh on Earth.

en-US.title: The One-Hand Lift
en-US.text: The {supply-pod:enter} {supply-pod:go to pad} supply pod had landed on the pad, and its biggest crate was a whopper. {supply-pod:live} Its side panels slid open, and there it was: a crate as big as a fridge. The {excavator:enter} excavator came trundling over {excavator:go to supply-pod} to lift it, slow and serious. {excavator:live} It dug up a scoop of dust first, just to warm up. But {woman:enter} Maya got there first. {woman:face happy} She bent her knees, gripped the crate… and lifted it. With one hand. {woman:hop} {excavator:wobble} {sfx:clunk} The excavator stopped with a clunk. [playfully] {woman:says} “What? On the Moon, it only weighs a sixth of what it does at home.” On Earth, nobody could lift that crate alone. {supply-pod:pulse} Here, it was like carrying a big pillow. {woman:spin} {woman:says} [mischievously] “Race you to the hatch!” {woman:go to hatch} {excavator:go to hatch} The excavator rumbled after her. [laughs] It never caught up. {excavator:shake 0.3} But it carried the next eleven crates, all in one go. {excavator:sparkle}

es-ES.title: Con una sola mano
es-ES.text: La {supply-pod:enter} {supply-pod:go to pad} cápsula de carga había aterrizado en la plataforma, y su caja más grande era enorme. {supply-pod:live} Sus paneles laterales se abrieron, y allí estaba: una caja grande como una nevera. La {excavator:enter} excavadora llegó traqueteando {excavator:go to supply-pod} para levantarla, despacio y muy seria. {excavator:live} Primero recogió una palada de polvo, para calentar. Pero {woman:enter} Maya llegó antes. {woman:face happy} Dobló las rodillas, agarró la caja… y la levantó. Con una mano. {woman:hop} {excavator:wobble} {sfx:clunk} La excavadora se paró en seco. [playfully] {woman:says} «¿Qué pasa? En la Luna pesa solo una sexta parte de lo que pesa en casa.» En la Tierra, nadie podría levantar esa caja a solas. {supply-pod:pulse} Aquí era como llevar un cojín grande. {woman:spin} {woman:says} [mischievously] «¡Te echo una carrera hasta la escotilla!» {woman:go to hatch} {excavator:go to hatch} La excavadora fue tras ella, traqueteando. [laughs] No la alcanzó nunca. {excavator:shake 0.3} Pero llevó las once cajas siguientes de una sola vez. {excavator:sparkle}
